title: Decision register — questions, information and answers
how_to_read: Each question lists what we KNOW (with official source), what we DO NOT KNOW, the current ANSWER/status, and exactly WHAT WOULD UNLOCK it. A decision is 'ready' only when every question it depends on is answered or explicitly accepted as risk.

rows.question: Where can we obtain a licensed betting-line archive (spreads, totals, moneylines) to grade S1-S4 against?
rows.known: The NFL publishes no betting lines on nfl.com; no price data exists anywhere in this repository.
rows.unknown: Whether a rights-cleared commercial feed (e.g., a licensed odds provider) fits the project's budget and data-use terms.
rows.answer: BLOCKED — every market column is blank, never proxied.
rows.unlock: Ingest a licensed odds feed; then gate G6 becomes evaluable.
rows.discover: Request trial access from licensed odds vendors; document terms; store closing lines at kick-off.

rows.question: What official source gives per-game player outcomes (passing/rushing/receiving yards, receptions) for 2026?
rows.known: nfl.com player pages show season totals; the team-stats page shows team aggregates only in the fetched rendering.
rows.unknown: Whether nfl.com game-book PDFs (linked per game) contain full player lines at scale, and whether bulk use is permitted.
rows.answer: BLOCKED for prop-combo grading — S5/S6 registered but nothing graded.
rows.unlock: Confirm a per-game player-stats source with usage rights; ingest 2026 game books.
rows.discover: Inspect the official game-book PDFs (linked from each game page) on a sample of games; if complete, automate extraction.

rows.question: Which players are starters vs 2nd/3rd/4th string on each unit?
rows.known: The official injury report gives practice and game status only. Official news names some starters (e.g., 'Drew Lock expected to start').
rows.unknown: The league publishes no depth chart (no official depth-chart page exists on nfl.com).
rows.answer: UNVERIFIED — starter/backup columns are blank by policy; deficiency tracking uses absences + official news instead.
rows.unlock: A league-published depth chart, or snap-count data from official game books.
rows.discover: Extract snap counts from official game-book PDFs to derive on-field usage tiers empirically.

rows.question: How much does losing a specific starter move our line?
rows.known: 326 official Week 10 injury rows;14 Out, 11 Questionable.
rows.unknown: Player-level value (no official player valuation exists; no snap counts).
rows.answer: Not quantified — would be inference. Lines are published without injury adjustments.
rows.unlock: Player usage data (snaps) + a pre-registered valuation model.
rows.discover: Pre-register an injury-adjustment model before looking at results, then test on future weeks.

rows.question: What is Lamar Jackson's actual absence timeline?
rows.known: Official nfl.com articles state both '6-9 weeks' (Nov 5) and '6-10 weeks' (Nov 13).
rows.unknown: Which timeline is authoritative.
rows.answer: Unresolved official-source discrepancy — flagged F-07. BAL lines carry no QB adjustment either way.
rows.unlock: A later official team statement.
rows.discover: Monitor nfl.com news; record every timeline statement with its date.

rows.question: Who starts at QB for Baltimore now, and is he a backup/third string?
rows.known: Lamar Jackson on IR (official); Tyler Huntley out for season (official).
rows.unknown: The official starter name for Week 10/11 is not stated on the pages fetched this session.
rows.answer: Open. The depth page lists BAL's QB absences without asserting a string number.
rows.unlock: Official depth-chart or week inactives article naming the starter.
rows.discover: Read the official Week 10 inactives/news pages Sunday; record starter names with links.

rows.question: How many graded selections are needed before rewards can be earned?
rows.known: Gate G2 requires >= 300 graded selections; the 2026 season offers at most ~272 games.
rows.unknown: Nothing — this is a design constant.
rows.answer: Multi-season accumulation is required: 2026 alone can never qualify a game-level strategy.
rows.unlock: Ingest 2024-2025 official archives and re-grade with the same frozen gates.
rows.discover: Extend the verified-games archive to prior seasons via official week pages.

rows.question: Is a 30-game holdout (weeks 8-10) enough to separate skill from luck?
rows.known: Bootstrap CI of margin-MAE improvement is [-2.47, +3.74] points/game — includes 0.
rows.unknown: True effect size.
rows.answer: No — the holdout direction is positive but not yet distinguishable from luck. This is why G5 fails honestly.
rows.unlock: Larger frozen holdout (rest of 2026 + 2025).
rows.discover: Freeze the model now; grade forward without changes.

rows.question: Why is fitted 2026 home-field advantage only +0.08 points?
rows.known: Historical NFL HFA is ~2.5 points; our fit on 137 games gives +0.08.
rows.unknown: Whether this reflects 2026 specifics, the peer archive's neutral flags (F-06), or noise.
rows.answer: Flagged F-05. Lines published with the fitted value; sensitivity noted.
rows.unlock: More games (season end) or corrected neutral flags.
rows.discover: Verify the 6 peer-flagged neutral games against official game pages.

rows.question: How correlated are parlay legs in practice?
rows.known: Game-level phi (model-internal): favorite-covers/over = -0.17; home-win/over = -0.22 on 105 games.
rows.unknown: Market-based correlations; all player-prop correlations.
rows.answer: Multiplicative pricing is NOT defensible for these pairs (|phi| up to 0.22); player-level remains blank.
rows.unlock: Market prices (Q1) and player outcomes (Q2).
rows.discover: Same as Q1/Q2.

rows.question: Can totals be forecast better than the naive running average?
rows.known: Holdout total MAE 11.35 vs naive 11.25 — model is slightly worse.
rows.unknown: Whether weather/QB inputs would help.
rows.answer: No current edge on totals; published unchanged.
rows.unlock: New pre-registered features (wind, QB status) tested on future weeks.
rows.discover: Pre-register a weather-feature model before Week 12.

rows.question: What do winners actually receive?
rows.known: Competition design allocates 6,000 reputation points; 0 awarded so far.
rows.unknown: Whether the requester wants funded prizes or recognition only.
rows.answer: Points are project reputation only (F-04).
rows.unlock: A decision on prize structure.
rows.discover: Reviewer chooses on the suggestions board (SUG-09).

rows.question: May NFL.com data be republished and used for betting research?
rows.known: Pages are publicly readable; this project stores transcribed values with source links.
rows.unknown: NFL digital-property terms of service were not examined this session.
rows.answer: Unverified legal position (F-14) — research use only for now.
rows.unlock: A legal review of NFL terms.
rows.discover: Read nfl.com terms of service; record relevant clauses.

rows.question: How often should lines and injury data refresh?
rows.known: Injury reports update daily in season; lines need kick-off prices.
rows.unknown: Automation capacity of this repository (currently manual agent sessions).
rows.answer: Weekly snapshots at minimum; injury pages should refresh Fri/Sat before kick-off.
rows.unlock: A scheduled CI job.
rows.discover: SUG-05 proposes a weekly capture workflow.

rows.question: Can same-game parlays be priced without proprietary SGP boards?
rows.known: SGP prices are bookmaker-proprietary; official sources publish none.
rows.unknown: Nothing — the answer is no.
rows.answer: S6 stays blocked; no proxy SGP pricing is invented.
rows.unlock: Licensed SGP prices.
rows.discover: None available from official sources; revisit if a licensed feed (Q1) includes SGP.

rows.question: Can we tell when a 2nd/3rd/4th-string player replaces a starter on defense?
rows.known: Injury Out/DNP statuses and official news name affected players; e.g., BUF added S Amani Hooker via trade (official news).
rows.unknown: Who lines up where — no official depth chart or snap data in scope.
rows.answer: Partial: absence-based deficiency tracking only (pages/depth.html).
rows.unlock: Snap counts from official game books (see Q3).
rows.discover: Sample-extract one game book to test feasibility.

rows.question: Do model improvements hold across season halves?
rows.known: Margin-MAE improvement is same-signed in weeks 3-6 (0.27 pts/game) and 7-10 (1.51 pts/game).
rows.unknown: Whether that continues.
rows.answer: G8 passes on sign consistency; magnitude unproven.
rows.unlock: Forward grading weeks 11-18.
rows.discover: Freeze and grade forward.

rows.question: Is our line sharper than the closing line?
rows.known: Nothing — no closing prices exist in any official source.
rows.unknown: Everything about CLV.
rows.answer: Cannot be answered without Q1.

rows.question: Which 2026 games are officially neutral-site?
rows.known: W10 NE@DET is official (Munich, on the official week page); W11 MIN@SF is official (Mexico City).
rows.unknown: Why the peer archive flags 6 other games neutral (incl. IND@WAS, BAL@DAL).
rows.answer: Flagged F-06; model zeroes HFA only for officially confirmed games... and peer-flagged games in the fit (sensitivity ~0).
rows.unlock: Official game pages for those 6 games.
rows.discover: Fetch the 6 game pages; record venue.

rows.question: Which of the 12 NFL workspaces is canonical?
rows.known: Each prior session published its own site under /nfl-*/.
rows.unknown: The requester's preference.
rows.answer: None is canonical yet; this workspace adds verified 2026-11-13 data and links the rest (F-13).
rows.unlock: A reviewer decision (SUG-12).
rows.discover: Reviewer picks an entry point on the suggestions board.
